- `storage.delete.removes` — After Delete, Has reports false and Get returns nil. Proven at any one of: unit, integration.
- `storage.get.returns_set` — Get returns the value Set stored for a key, and nil for a key that does not exist. Proven at any one of: unit, integration.
- `storage.iterator.visits_every_key` — Iterator traverses a snapshot of the storage, yielding every stored key once and never the offset key. Proven at any one of: unit, integration.
- `storage.offset.roundtrip` — GetOffset returns the offset SetOffset stored. Proven at any one of: unit, integration.
- `storage.range.half_open` — IteratorWithRange(start, limit) yields exactly the keys in the half-open range [start, limit). Proven at any one of: unit, integration.
- `storage.seek.never_backward` — After Seek(key), the next key the iterator yields is never before key. Proven at any one of: unit, integration.
